observations.theme_token_pairs_methodology: Redone per team-lead's refinement: deduped by distinct (foreground, background, role, font) PAIR, not by site — contrast is a function of the pair. Classification method: every Theme.secondaryLabel/Theme.accent call site was extracted via `rg -n`, then each call site's FILE was classified by which container pattern it uses — confirmed by reading the actual container code, not guessed: (a) 'card_material_or_solid' = file itself calls `.themeCard()`/`.themeCapsule()`, OR its List applies `.listRowBackground(CardBackground())` — both resolve to the identical ThemedBackground fill (.ultraThinMaterial light / #111111 dark, see SITE-0007); (b) 'list_row_system_default' = file has a List with NO CardBackground override, so rows sit on the system's own list-row background (adapts automatically, not app-controlled); (c) 'no_local_container' = the file has neither — these are almost all Section/Row/Card/Banner COMPONENTS with no container of their own, rendered inside a PARENT screen's List. I traced the actual callers for the largest of these (SubstanceDetailView, SessionDetailView, EntryDetailView, ToleranceToolView, MyMedsHubView) and confirmed all five apply `.listRowBackground(CardBackground())` to their List, so their child Section/Row/Card/Banner components inherit that card fill too — meaning the true 'card_material_or_solid' count is materially higher than the file-local count below. I did NOT trace every remaining caller individually (would require opening ~60 more parent files); the residual in 'no_local_container' below is a mix of (i) further card-embedded components I didn't individually verify, and (ii) confirmed genuinely-bare cases: SessionShareImage.swift sits directly on `.background(Theme.background)` (it's the off-screen PNG share-image renderer, not a normal screen), SubstanceShareSheet.swift/SessionShareSheet.swift render their pill chips on `.regularMaterial` capsules (a third, distinct background — share-card chips, not the app's card system), and OnboardingView.swift/GlassPillButton.swift/DiscordPromptView.swift appear to sit directly on Theme.background with no card. Flagging this honestly rather than asserting false certainty at 789-site scale.

accessibility_contrast_settings_handling.result: ZERO matches across all 4 targets (Piru, Shared, PiruWidget, PiruLiveActivityExtension) — confirmed via `rg -i` for each term, no hits.
accessibility_contrast_settings_handling.implication: Every hardcoded/token color in this inventory (Theme.legibleYellow, Theme.secondaryLabel, RouteOfAdministration.tintHexPair, all PresetColor/hex/rgb literals, the print-only PDF palette, etc.) bypasses the system semantic colors entirely, so NONE of them respond to iOS Settings > Accessibility > Display & Text Size > Increase Contrast, nor to Reduce Transparency (relevant for the .ultraThinMaterial/.regularMaterial card and popover backgrounds, SITE-0007 and others) — the app has no code path that would change behavior under either setting. This is a system-wide gap, not a per-site one.
